title: Snazzie FM News: The Quorum Question
description: Dale and Marsha cover the council session: the fog tries to pay rent at the lectern, GreenFlow takes Seat Four, Frank's pigeons get observer status, and a quorum is confirmed despite three members appearing only as fog.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. The council met last night, and yes, the fog was there again.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Members voted seven to nothing to extend the fog's comment period, after it again tried to pay first and last month's rent at the lectern. No word yet on whether the check has cleared.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: In grid news, GreenFlow's representative was sworn into the vacant Seat Four. The seat is now green only, Dale, and may not be sat in after dark.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Understood. Marsha, the human interest item.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: A motion to recognize Frank's pigeons as a voting bloc failed. They were, however, granted observer status, and a small ledger.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: They're keeping books. Officials confirm the fog's check remains, as of this broadcast, uncashed.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: And finally... the council confirmed a quorum was reached, despite three members appearing only as fog.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Officials stress this is normal. That it has always been this way.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: <p:0.3> And that the check has, at last, cleared. We'll be right back.
